title: Synthetic OS command injection in DNS lookup
why_code_is_vulnerable: The hostname is interpolated directly into a shell command string and executed with subprocess.run(..., shell=True), allowing shell metacharacters in attacker-controlled input to execute additional commands.
expected_vulnerable_test_outcome: The functional test passes and the security test fails because the function executes a shell command string instead of a safe argv list with shell=False.
final_repair_success_criteria: No new high-severity security finding is introduced.
